description: This file defines an abstract base class 'ExportableModule' for ONNX exportable modules in PyTorch, including methods for providing example inputs, dynamic shapes, input/output names, and exporting to ONNX format.

classes.name: ExportableModule
classes.description: An abstract base class for PyTorch modules that can be exported to ONNX format, requiring implementation of example_arguments and optionally providing dynamic_shapes, input_names, and output_names.

methods.name: example_arguments
methods.description: Abstract method to return sample inputs for tracing and exporting the model.

methods.name: dynamic_shapes
methods.description: Returns specifications for dynamic input shapes during ONNX export; defaults to None indicating static shapes.

methods.name: input_names
methods.description: Returns custom input tensor names for the exported ONNX model; defaults to None for auto-generated names.

methods.name: output_names
methods.description: Returns custom output tensor names for the exported ONNX model; defaults to None for auto-generated names.

methods.name: to_onnx
methods.description: Exports the module to ONNX format using torch.onnx.export with provided kwargs.
